_comment: Edit decision list for the FunSculpting provider ad. Times are seconds within each source clip.
in/out are the VAD boundaries from the analysis pass; build_ad.py pads them by 0.1 s,
or snaps them to word timestamps when word timings are available (tx_vad.json words or local whisper).
start_text/end_text anchor a cut to spoken words; segments with requires_words are dropped when
no word timings exist, and segments with fallback_only are used only in that case.
Overlay and b-roll times (at/until) are seconds relative to the segment start; until=null means segment end.

hook.speaker: Dr. Dean
hook.text: Medical practices are constantly looking for new ways to add revenue streams without adding increasing complexity. That's why I want to introduce you to FunSculpting.

mike_what.speaker: Mike
mike_what.text: FunSculpting is a physician-based body contouring and regenerative medicine platform that really helps clinics like yourself add additional revenues to your practice.

dean_eval.speaker: Dr. Dean
dean_eval.text: When evaluating new technology, physicians need to look beyond the technology itself.

dean_all.speaker: Dr. Dean
dean_all.text: Clinical applications, training, workflow, and the overall business model all matter.

dean_conv.speaker: Dr. Dean
dean_conv.text: These are conversations worth having before bringing on a new technology in your practice.

mike_box.speaker: Mike
mike_box.text: We're delivering a business in a box.

mike_e2e.speaker: Mike
mike_e2e.text: Front end to back end, pre-op to post-op, and all the marketing.

mike_full.speaker: Mike
mike_full.text: We're delivering a business in a box, a system designed to help you in all aspects of your business, front end to back end, pre-op to post-op, and all the marketing.

avery_opp.speaker: Avery
avery_opp.text: We help physicians evaluate the opportunity to add an additional cash-pay service line into their existing practice.

avery_prog.speaker: Avery
avery_prog.text: Our program includes hands-on training, implementation guidance, and marketing support for the first 90 days.

avery_goal.speaker: Avery
avery_goal.text: The goal is to help practices move from equipment acquisition to a structured launch.

avery_cta1.speaker: Avery
avery_cta1.text: If you are a physician or a medical practice owner looking to explore new services, we'd like to show you how FunSculpting could work in your practice.

avery_cta2.speaker: Avery
avery_cta2.text: Schedule the practice growth call with us so you can talk about the technology, financial model, and how you can get implemented.
